text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Oguri-chan.
I'm so happy, it really touched my heart!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: (Is this... a dream? It feels... nice...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the cafeteria during lunch break, I spotted
Oguri Cap, Tamamo Cross, and Inari One
having some sort of argument.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, Inari. Let me carry your trays.
Please don't hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, ya don't gotta baby us like that!
I can carry my own lunch, for crying out loud.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I might be petite, but I ain't losin' when it comes to muscle!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya see, this Oguri here
apparently had some weird dream—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—And so, everyone thanked me,
and I woke up with a warm feeling inside.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Say what!? That's gotta be a divine sign
tellin' ya to do good deeds for folks—just kiddin'!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A divine sign... I see, so that's what it was!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, let me carry your bags.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-What's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The track conditions are rough today.
Inari, if you like, I can give you a piggyback ride.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here!
How'm I supposed to train like that, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, do you want to erase the blackboard?
I will lift you up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yay, uppy-uppy—!
...Wait, why the heck are ya doin' that?! I can erase it myself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—An' so, she's been like this all mornin'.
Guess it's my fault too for teasin' her about divine signs, though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We can take care of ourselves, ya know.
Direct that fine spirit of yours toward someone else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, but...
I want to be of help to the two of you as well.
choice_data_list: Since she's offering, why not let her do something?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Something? Like what, for example?
choice_data_list: How about having her share a side dish...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What kind of crazy talk is that?!
Hey, Oguri! That was just an example, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Share my food? I had never even considered it.
However... gh, today's meal is... karaage...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No way, stop! Takin' food away from Oguri,
there's no way we could—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was just a casual suggestion,
but apparently I had touched upon a forbidden taboo.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! We totally get it,
ya don't gotta force yourself!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...No, Tama, do not stop me!
This will prove whether my feelings are genuine!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If it is for the two of you... I will hold back my tears.
Please accept this piece... of my heartfelt dedication...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo & Inari
text_block_list.text: O... Oguri~!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the food... but seriously, that blew my mind.
Never thought I'd see the day Oguri shares her meal.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still... it was ridiculously tasty!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... you're gonna make me tear up.
I definitely felt your heartfelt spirit there...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... Inari...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them stared at each other, deeply moved.
While feeling touched by their fiery friendship—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I began to feel guilty, so I decided to
give some of my own side dishes to Oguri Cap.
